services.title: Luxury Wedding Photography
services.shortDescription: A seamless blend of high-fashion editorial portraiture and discreet candid photojournalism.
services.fullDescription: Our signature wedding photography service is designed for couples who value art, emotion, and unhurried luxury. We capture the grand spectacle as well as the quiet, intimate glances that often go unnoticed. Every photograph is hand-graded to achieve our signature warm filmic aesthetic.
deliverables: Full coverage by 2 Lead Photographers & 2 Associate Artists
700+ Hand-Curated and Individually Color-Graded High-Res Photographs
Handmade Linen Fine-Art Heirloom Album (40 Spreads / 80 Pages)
Private Online Proofing & Download Gallery for Guests
Next-Day 25 Sneak-Peek Images for Social Media
equipment: Sony FX3 & A7R V Medium-Format Hybrid Bodies
Prime G-Master Lenses (35mm f/1.4, 50mm f/1.2, 85mm f/1.4)
services.timeline: Full delivery within 5 to 7 weeks; Sneak peeks within 48 hours

services.title: Cinematic Wedding Feature Films
services.shortDescription: Narrative-driven 4K cinema films with bespoke audio recording, vows integration, and custom scoring.
services.fullDescription: We don't create generic music videos; we craft emotional heirlooms. We mic the couple and family during key moments to weave genuine spoken vows, parents' blessings, and ambient laughter into an unforgettable cinematic documentary.
deliverables: 3-5 Minute Cinematic Trailer / Teaser Film (4K UHD)
18-25 Minute Documentary Feature Wedding Film
Full Multi-Cam Video Coverage of Key Rituals (Pheras, Sangeet Performances, Speeches)
Custom Licensed Soundtracks & Master Audio Design
Delivered in a Bespoke Engraved Wooden USB Box & Cloud Stream
equipment: Arri & Sony FX6 Cinema Cameras with anamorphic lenses
DJI Ronin RS3 Pro Gimbals & Wireless Follow Focus
Sennheiser Lavalier & Sound Devices Audio Recording
Licensed DJI Cinema Drone Aerial Cinematography
services.timeline: Trailer within 3 weeks; Full feature film within 8 weeks

services.title: Pre-Wedding Concepts & Films
services.shortDescription: Editorial storytelling sessions in breathtaking heritage forts, coastal sunsets, or intimate architectural spaces.
services.fullDescription: A creative space to celebrate your chemistry away from the wedding commotion. We style, scout, and storyboard romantic narratives that reflect who you both are.
deliverables: 1 or 2 Days of Tailored On-Location Shoot
Styling & Moodboard Consultation with Creative Director
120+ Retouched Fine-Art Digital Images
2-3 Minute Cinematic Concept Film / Music Video
Display Frame Print for Reception Entry
services.timeline: Delivered within 3 weeks of shoot date

services.title: Engagements & Roka Ceremonies
services.shortDescription: Intimate coverage capturing the first auspicious chapter of two families uniting.
services.fullDescription: From traditional Sagan and ring exchanges to the lively cocktail after-party, we capture the joy, family heirlooms, and elegance of your engagement ceremony.
deliverables: Dedicated 2-Artist Team (Photo + Video)
250+ Color-Graded High-Resolution Photographs
3-Minute Highlight Film
Online Private Gallery with 1-Year Cloud Storage

services.title: Receptions & Sangeet Nights
services.shortDescription: High-energy celebration coverage with dynamic stage lighting mastery and candid party captures.
services.fullDescription: Sangeet and reception celebrations demand mastery of theatrical stage lighting, fast-paced choreography, and uninhibited emotional energy. We document the electrifying atmosphere without killing the vibe.
deliverables: Complete Stage Performance Multi-Cam Recording
High-Energy Highlight Teaser Video
300+ Candid & Stage Retouched Images
Audio Feeds Direct from Sound Console

services.title: Maternity & Family Heirloom Portraits
services.shortDescription: Gentle, natural-light studio and home portraiture celebrating life's most tender transitions.
services.fullDescription: Subtle, soulful, and organic portraiture capturing motherhood and family legacy. Shot with soft daylight, neutral styling, and deep sensitivity.
deliverables: 2-Hour Intimate Session (In-Studio or Private Residence)
Wardrobe & Color Harmony Guidance
60 Hand-Mastered High-Resolution Digital Photographs
Handmade Linen Mini Folio Print Box

services.title: Milestone Birthdays & Anniversaries
services.shortDescription: Celebrations of life, decade milestones, and silver/golden anniversaries preserved with timeless grace.
services.fullDescription: Whether it's an intimate 50th birthday dinner or a grand 25th wedding anniversary with multi-generational families, we create an album of togetherness you will treasure for decades.
deliverables: Comprehensive Event Documentation
Family Legacy Group Portraits
150+ Retouched Digital Photos
Short Keepsake Video Reel (60-90 Seconds)

services.title: Destination Weddings & Bespoke Packages
services.shortDescription: All-inclusive multi-day global coverage with seamless travel logistics and dedicated crew.
services.fullDescription: From royal palaces in Rajasthan and cliffside resorts in Goa to Tuscany villas and Dubai desert ballrooms, our team manages end-to-end multi-day travel, sunrise-to-late-night coverage, and multi-cultural ceremonies.
deliverables: Comprehensive 3 to 4 Days Coverage of All Ceremonies
Complete Photography & Cinematography Crew (6-8 Artists)
Daily Same-Day Social Snippets for Guests
Full Feature Cinema Film + Teaser + Instagram Reels
2 Luxury Royal Silk Heirloom Albums + 2 Parents' Miniature Books
